summary: All targets and reuse hooks EXIST and behave as the architecture spec claims. Both folds (CF1, TR2) are empirically real. No DB_VERSION bump required. AP-COACH-8 and AP-COACH-1 constraints are both satisfiable with the planned design.

CF1.claim: Coach.svelte onLadderMove calls only ladder.report(); the ~14 diagnostic probe attempts are never written to attempts/SRS/weaknessCounters (no attemptsRepo import).

evidence.attemptsRepo_import: ABSENT (imports verified lines 1-18; only loadPlayerModel from store/playerModel)
evidence.probe_count: COACH_LADDER_MAX=2 per theme x (6 COACH_MOTIF_PROBES + 1 endgame) = ~14 puzzles, scored whether solved or not (diagnostic.ts:15-22)

TR2.claim: weaknessCounters is written but READ nowhere except ?? {} backfill; trainer selection (loadNext) ignores it.

evidence.loadNext_lines: src/ui/Tactics.svelte:117-161 — selection priority is drillThemes -> personal -> curated; NEVER reads model.weaknessCounters
evidence.stale_comment: runAnalysis.ts:67-68 claims weaknessCounters is 'used by the trainer's personalised selection and the dashboard' — EMPIRICALLY FALSE; no selection or dashboard read exists. Fix the comment in this PR.

recordTacticsAttempt.signature: recordTacticsAttempt(opts: { attempt: PuzzleAttemptRecord; puzzle: Puzzle; model: PlayerModel; srs: { kind: SrsItemKind; refId: string; grade: Grade }; now: number }): Promise<SrsCardRecord>
recordTacticsAttempt.side_effects: ONE atomic IndexedDB tx over ['puzzleAttempts','puzzles','srsCards','playerModel']: writes attempt log, puzzle row (its drifting rating), graded FSRS card, and the supplied player model. Grades FSRS via pure gradeCard/newCard. Returns the new card.
recordTacticsAttempt.weaknessCounters_fold: DOES NOT fold weaknessCounters itself — it persists whatever model the CALLER passes. The caller (Tactics.finish / Review.grade) mutates model.weaknessCounters BEFORE calling and passes $state.snapshot(model). So weaknessCounters is caller-owned, not repo-owned.
recordTacticsAttempt.rating_pool_note: It writes opts.puzzle (the puzzle's own Glicko) and opts.model.puzzleRating. To honor AP-COACH-8, coach probe recording MUST pass the puzzle UNCHANGED and a model whose puzzleRating is UNCHANGED.

fsrs.newCard_gradeCard: pure; Date passed as `now` epoch ms

PuzzleRepo.next.themes_param: PuzzleQuery.themes?: string[] — accept() keeps a puzzle if it has ANY of the listed themes (line 147, OR-semantics)
PuzzleRepo.next.selection_internals: rating-window filter -> sort by |rating-target| -> deterministic id-hash pick among closest <=8 (no Math.random; PURE-ish, uses hashId). Bias point for weakness steering is the `themes` arg, not internal scoring.

reuse_hooks.weaknessCounters_increment_sites: Tactics.svelte:231-235, Review.svelte:122, runAnalysis.ts:71-77 (all guard on miss / player-color motif)

playerModel.persistModel: app.persistModel(now) writes the in-memory model; recordTacticsAttempt writes it inside the atomic tx instead

app_state_hooks.tacticsFilterThemes: src/state/app.svelte.ts:46 ($state<string[]|null>) — the existing dashboard 'Drill' filter the trainer already honors first in loadNext

tac_trainer.playUserMove: returns 'correct'|'solved'|'wrong'; coach onLadderMove already uses it via PuzzleLadder.next() trainer
tac_trainer.elapsedMs: elapsedMs(now) available for an ms field on coach probe attempts
tac_trainer.gradeAttempt: PURE function returning {player, puzzle} Ratings; mutates NOTHING (TacticalTrainer.ts:93-115). The ladder uses it for the ladder's OWN rating only — never persists puzzleRating.
